$comment: Warning waivers per the HIVE brief: each records owner, reason, expiry, and retest. approvalStatus is 'proposed' until Kody explicitly ratifies in writing (then it becomes 'ratified' with ratifiedOn). scripts/audit-gate.mjs treats matched-but-proposed waivers as HOLD (exit 3), never as approval; it also verifies each waiver's package and severity against the live audit report and enforces expiry so waived findings resurface.
$history: 2026-09-06: the two proposed image-size waivers (GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr, GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq, both high, proposed 2026-08-21, never ratified) were removed by their own recorded retest instruction — 'remove this waiver as soon as a fixed image-size release ships' — after the SDK 57 patch refresh dropped image-size from the dependency tree entirely (npm ls image-size: empty; neither advisory appears in the regenerated audit). Full text preserved in git history and in the docs/plans record of that date. Nothing was ratified.
